dependencies.name: goexif
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — reads EXIF fields (GPS, camera, date) to show what was found. Metadata removal itself is a hand-written, lossless JPEG/PNG segment stripper (internal/engine/jpeg.go, png.go), not this library. Not a separate install; listed for transparency about what this app is built on.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.
